properties.site-address: Sevenoaks Garden Centre, Main Road, Sundridge
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: The site comprises a garden centre containing a number of single storey buildings, a large car park, an area for storing containers and a hand car wash. Bounded by Dryhill Lane and the A25 to the west and north, a row of cottages to the north east, and open countryside to the east and south. Mature trees line the eastern and southern boundaries of the site.
